changeinfo.changes: A fix has been made for the trophy "Invincible Defender". Thunderstorms now use the correct background assets. Fixed an issue where the wrong leaderboard was being displayed. Fixed an issue where boss kills were not being tracked correctly.

The effects of multiple hats have been adjusted. Toetag Stanley can no longer be challenged in Boss Rush before being unlocked. Killing a boss and dying in the same update frame no longer locks up controls. The upgraded mucus launcher's power has been adjusted. The laser and upgraded laser's power have been adjusted. The Pacifish awardment has been adjusted to allow for bouncy castles. Dave has escaped. Thunderstorm effects in Mild VFX have been adjusted. Display logic for mid-wave info bubbles has been adjusted. Leaderboards have been moved to the Title screen. Fixed the Ludum Double Dare awardment. Fixed Round-end awardments being earnable on Game Overs.
Added visual reflection effect to upgraded shotgun. Fixed a bug with the cigar. Dave has been armed.
